g.text: World height (m); geometric lighting, not error
Identical camera and physical scale; fixed ground-truth boxes + 0.18 m are used for display only.
Local panels show only original triangles wholly inside the fixed display box. Metrics are copied from the full-scene evaluation,
not recomputed on these crops. All four instances are included; colors represent world height with geometric illumination.
